name: Payment Instrument 1 Code
definition: Specifies the payment instrument used or the underlying financial transaction that resulted in a payment transaction.

BDT.name: Bank Debit Transfer
BDT.definition: Direct debit instruction in which the debtor and the creditor are financial institutions.

BCT.name: Bank Credit Transfer
BCT.definition: Funds transfer in which the debtor and the creditor are financial institutions.

CDT.name: Customer Debit Transfer
CDT.definition: Direct debit instruction in which the debtor or the creditor or both are non-financial institutions.

CCT.name: Customer Credit Transfer
CCT.definition: Funds transfer in which the debtor or the creditor or both are non-financial institutions.

CHK.name: Cheque
CHK.definition: Payment instrument is a cheque. (A written order on which instructions are given to an account holder (a financial institution) to pay a stated sum to a named recipient (the payee)).

BKT.name: Book Transfer
BKT.definition: Transfer that is a movement of cash on the books of the account servicer.

DCP.name: Debit Card Payment
DCP.definition: Payment instrument is a debit card. (The payment originated using a debit card scheme.).

CCP.name: Credit Card Payment
CCP.definition: Payment instrument is a credit card. (The payment originated using a credit card scheme.).

RTI.name: Return
RTI.definition: Entry related to a returned or unpaid item.

CAN.name: Cancellation Request
CAN.definition: Reverse entry that is the result of the cancellation of a previously booked entry.
